_comment: Terrain types. `signals` is what the PRINTED map appears to promise about a hex; hidden contents (in the map file) are the truth. A mismatch between the two is an intentional authoring tool, not a bug.

terrains.label: Maintained Trail
terrains.visibleClue: Blazed and boot-packed. Someone comes through here.

terrains.label: Second Growth
terrains.visibleClue: Even-aged firs in rows. Unnervingly tidy.

terrains.label: Old Growth
terrains.visibleClue: Trunks wider than a car. Very little light.

terrains.label: Sphagnum Bog
terrains.visibleClue: Standing water and skunk cabbage. Slow going.

terrains.label: Basalt Ridge
terrains.visibleClue: Exposed rock. You can see a long way from up there.

terrains.label: Clearcut Unit
terrains.visibleClue: Stumps, slash, and no cover whatsoever.

terrains.label: Creek Bottom
terrains.visibleClue: Fast water over slick stones. Loud enough to hide things.

terrains.label: Tarn
terrains.visibleClue: Open water. Deeper than it looks.

terrains.label: Blowdown Tangle
terrains.visibleClue: Windthrow stacked three deep. Nobody is getting through.

terrains.label: Field Station
terrains.visibleClue: A Department outbuilding. Forms available at all hours.
